title: Derived section pullback intertwines the two single-object units
statement: Let f:X→Y be any morphism of schemes and M an abelian étale sheaf on Y. Put Q=f*, F=Γ(Y,-), R=Γ(X,-), and let τ:RΓ(Y,-)→D(Q)RΓ(X,-) be the derived adjunction unit followed by Leray, as in lem-sbc-derived-section-pullback-zero. Using the real construction u of lem-sbc-right-derived-single-zero-unit, and the exact single comparison c_Q, one has u_F(M)≫τ_(M[0])≫RR(c_Q,M.hom)=singleFunctor.map(globalSectionsUpperStarMap f M)≫u_R(QM). This equation precedes application of homology and requires no acyclicity or injectivity of M.

source.place: Lemma 21.19.1, derived adjunction; rightDerivedFunctorCompIso defining composite unit; unit–Leray calculation in Sheaf.Paper.EtaleKInjectiveUnitLeray.

proof.text: Use derivedη_fac_app to factor the derived adjunction unit through the underived unit and right-derived unit. Apply Γ and its unit naturality. The factorization of rightDerivedFunctorCompIso identifies the resulting composite unit with the Γ unit after Leray. This is the unit–Leray identity on arbitrary homotopy complexes, so no injectivity is needed.

Apply the identity to the homotopy image of M[0]. The exact inverse-image single comparison is its localization factorization followed by Q of mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor.hom. Move the latter through the R right-derived unit by naturality. In degree zero the remaining chain map is Γ of the underived adjunction unit followed by lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso, hence ordinary section pullback. All other source degrees are zero; from_single_hom_ext proves the chain-map equality. Localize, reassociate and obtain the equation for the real units u. This includes zero sheaves and empty schemes.

theorem derivedSectionPullback_single_unit {Y X : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) :
    (let τ : rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} Y ⟶
        D(upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f) ⋙
          rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} X :=
      Functor.whiskerRight
        (mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).unit
        (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} Y) ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft D(upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f)
        (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'
          (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f)
          (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
          (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f)
              (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
                terminalIsTerminal) ≪≫
            lowerStarCompSheafSectionsTerminalIso AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f ≪≫
            (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              terminalIsTerminal).symm)).hom
    let Q := upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f
    let F := Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
    let R := Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
    F.rightDerivedSingleUnit M ≫
      τ.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M) ≫
      R.rightDerivedFunctor.map ((Q.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app M) =
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} 0).map
        (globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f M) ≫
      R.rightDerivedSingleUnit (Q.obj M))
